---
title: Column spanners
---

A spanner is a label over a run of columns. Name it with a formula, or call `lt_spanner()` with no arguments to infer spanners from shared prefixes such as `Sepal.` and `Petal.`. Use `sep` for other separators.

```{r}
library(lt)
tbl = lt(head(iris, 3))
tbl |> lt_spanner(Sepal ~ Sepal.Length + Sepal.Width)
tbl |> lt_spanner()

d = data.frame(`Sales:Q1` = 1:2, `Sales:Q2` = 3:4, `Cost:Q1` = 5:6, check.names = FALSE)
lt(d) |> lt_spanner(sep = ":")
```
